2026-03-24.zh: 今日研发主要聚焦于Graph/Runtime模块，新增对NPU设备上Qwen3-next及VLM模型LLM部分的支持，同时修复多处关键bug，包括MoE参数设置和beam search序列停止问题。高风险改动涉及NPU设备支持，测试需重点关注分布式运行时、NPU推理性能及稳定性，以及服务注册恢复和序列生成的正确性。
2026-03-24.en: Today's development focused on the Graph/Runtime module, adding support for Qwen3-next and the LLM part of the VLM model on NPU devices, alongside multiple critical bug fixes including MoE parameter settings and beam search sequence stopping. High-risk changes involve NPU device support, with testing emphasis on distributed runtime, NPU inference performance and stability, service registration recovery, and sequence generation correctness.

2026-03-23.zh: 今日研发重点涵盖xllm/core多模态输入错误提示重构、推理引擎多优先级调度参数优化及分布式进程管理修复，设备后端序列并行阶段优化风险较高。重要模块包括xllm/core、推理引擎、设备后端及Spec Decode。测试需关注多模态输入错误处理、调度逻辑正确性、进程退出清理、设备多卡性能及新接口v1/sample的功能稳定性。
2026-03-23.en: Today's development focused on refactoring multimodal input error messages in xllm/core, improving multi-priority scheduling parameters and fixing distributed process cleanup in the Inference Engine, with high-risk optimizations in the Device Backend's sequence parallel phase. Key modules include xllm/core, Inference Engine, Device Backend, and Spec Decode. Testing should emphasize error handling accuracy, scheduling correctness, proper process termination, multi-device performance, and stability of the new v1/sample interface.

2026-03-20.zh: 今日研发主要聚焦于NPU后端性能优化与功能增强，新增支持带不同前缀的模型权重加载，同时推理引擎模块新增统一请求统计日志。重要模块包括NPU后端、xllm/core及推理引擎，整体风险较低但需关注性能优化和并行策略下的稳定性。测试重点为性能提升效果、权重加载兼容性、并行策略下lmhead正确性及日志准确性。
2026-03-20.en: Today's development focused on performance optimization and feature enhancements in the NPU backend, including support for loading model weights with varied prefixes, along with adding unified request statistics logs in the Inference Engine. Key modules involved are the NPU backend, xllm/core, and the Inference Engine. Although overall risk is low, testing should emphasize performance improvements, weight loading compatibility, correctness of lmhead under parallel strategy, and accuracy of the new logging.

2026-03-19.zh: 今日研发重点涵盖Graph/Runtime、推理引擎及xllm/core模块，完成了多项重构、性能优化及新特性开发。高风险变更主要集中在graph_mode设计文档更新，需重点关注文档准确性和完整性。测试应重点验证多服务错误处理、模型加载正确性及新推理解析器检测器的功能表现。
2026-03-19.en: Today's development focused on Graph/Runtime, Inference Engine, and xllm/core modules, including refactoring, performance improvements, and new feature additions. The high-risk change involved updates to the graph_mode design documentation, requiring careful verification of accuracy and completeness. Testing should emphasize error handling in multi-service scenarios, correctness of model loading, and functionality of new reasoning parser detectors.

2026-03-18.zh: 今日研发重点集中在图计算与运行时模块，新增了滚动权重加载和MLU上glm-5 w8a8模型支持，涉及多个核心文件且风险较高。xllm核心模块新增了进程绑定NUMA区域功能，提升性能。测试需重点关注权重加载和多设备深度注意力机制的正确性及性能，同时验证UTF-8处理、构建流程和constexpr重构的稳定性。
2026-03-18.en: Today's development focused on the Graph and Runtime modules, introducing rolling weight loading and support for glm-5 w8a8 on MLU with high-risk changes. The xllm core module added process pinning to the correct NUMA region to enhance performance. Testing should emphasize correctness and performance of weight loading and multi-device deep attention, as well as stability of UTF-8 handling, build process, and constexpr refactoring.

2026-03-17.zh: 今日研发主要聚焦于图计算与运行时、模型支持及NPU后端模块的bug修复与代码重构，特别是改进离线推理接口和修复多轮分段预填充图失败等高风险问题。涉及模块包括Graph/Runtime、Model Support、xllm/c_api及NPU Backend。测试重点关注编译链接依赖的正确性、指针相关功能的兼容性，以及离线推理和分布式运行时的稳定性。
2026-03-17.en: Today's development focused on bug fixes and refactoring across Graph/Runtime, Model Support, xllm/c_api, and NPU Backend modules, with significant improvements to the offline inference interface and fixes for high-risk issues like multi-round piecewise prefill graph failures. Key testing areas include verifying successful compilation and linkage, pointer-related functionality compatibility, and the stability of offline inference and distributed runtime components.

2026-03-16.zh: 今日研发重点在Graph / Runtime模块启用MLU上的DeepSeek v32预填充序列并行功能，同时对类型定义进行了重构，并修复了NPU环境配置中的关键路径设置问题。此次提交涉及高风险改动，需重点关注MLU设备性能表现、类型替换的正确性及NPU环境变量配置的有效性。测试应覆盖新功能性能验证及环境初始化的稳定性。
2026-03-16.en: Today's development focused on enabling DeepSeek v32 prefill sequence parallelism on MLU within the Graph / Runtime module, refactoring type definitions, and fixing a critical path setting in the NPU environment setup. The changes carry high risk, requiring attention to MLU performance, correctness of type alias replacements, and proper NPU environment variable configuration. Testing should emphasize performance validation and environment initialization stability.

2026-07-29.zh: 今日研发重点涵盖Graph/Runtime、NPU后端及Spec Decode等核心模块，新增了xllm服务器自动调优和DeepSeekV4 NPU的FlashComm1序列并行支持。存在高风险变更，主要集中在Spec Decode模块的Qwen35 MTP性能优化。测试需重点关注自动配置准确性、接口数据格式、空分片处理及性能验证，确保系统稳定性与兼容性。
2026-07-29.en: Today's development focused on core modules including Graph/Runtime, NPU Backend, and Spec Decode, with new features such as auto-tuning for the xllm server and FlashComm1 sequence parallelism support for DeepSeekV4 NPU. A high-risk change was identified in the Spec Decode module related to Qwen35 MTP performance optimization. Testing should emphasize accuracy of auto-configuration, correctness of API response formats, handling of empty shards, and performance validation to ensure system stability and compatibility.

2026-07-28.zh: 今日研发主要聚焦于推理引擎和NPU后端模块，完成了缓存管理优化、设备前缀缓存支持及多项NPU相关bug修复。新增了GLM 5.2 MLU预填充支持和命令行界面增强，涉及中等风险改动。测试重点关注缓存清理、预编译流程稳定性、多设备功能及NPU同步和计算精度。
2026-07-28.en: Today's development focused on the Inference Engine and NPU Backend modules, implementing cache management optimizations, device prefix cache support, and multiple NPU bug fixes. New features include GLM 5.2 MLU prefill support and CLI enhancements, involving medium-risk changes. Testing should emphasize cache cleanup correctness, precompile stability, multi-device functionality, and NPU synchronization and computation accuracy.

2026-07-27.zh: 今日研发重点集中在Spec Decode、推理引擎及NPU后端等核心模块，涵盖性能优化、功能新增及多项bug修复。高风险改动主要涉及推理引擎的DSV4设备缓存支持和NPU上下文并行分区重构，测试需重点关注异步状态处理、分布式通信及构建流程的稳定性。需加强对第三方模块分支切换和新操作的验证，确保整体系统功能和性能的稳定提升。
2026-07-27.en: Today's development focused on core modules including Spec Decode, Inference Engine, and NPU Backend, covering performance improvements, new features, and multiple bug fixes. High-risk changes involved DSV4 device prefix cache support in the Inference Engine and refactoring of NPU context parallel partitioning, with testing emphasis on asynchronous state handling, distributed communication, and build stability. Attention is also required on third-party module branch switching and new operation validation to ensure overall system functionality and performance stability.

2026-03-14.zh: 今日研发主要聚焦于NPU后端模块的性能优化，通过在多个文件中引入unordered_set提升部分场景的执行效率。此次改动风险中等，需重点关注对Ascend设备的兼容性及性能提升效果。测试工作应围绕性能验证和设备适配展开。
2026-03-14.en: Today's development focused on performance optimization in the NPU backend module by utilizing unordered_set in multiple files to improve execution efficiency in certain cases. The changes carry medium risk, with testing emphasis on performance improvements and compatibility with Ascend devices. Testing should concentrate on verifying performance gains and device adaptation.

2026-03-13.zh: 今日研发重点围绕NPU后端和图计算/运行时模块，完成了对CANN 8.5和PyTorch 2.7.1的适配，并在lm head实现了行并行以支持更多词汇表大小。修复了多模态嵌入模型同步和解码实例重复请求导致的崩溃问题，整体风险较低。测试需重点关注NPU设备兼容性、性能表现及新增功能的正确性和稳定性。
2026-03-13.en: Today's development focused on the NPU backend and graph/runtime modules, including adaptation for CANN 8.5 and PyTorch 2.7.1, and implementing row parallelism in the lm head to support larger vocabularies. Bug fixes addressed synchronization in multi-modal embedding and stability under duplicate decode requests, with low overall risk. Testing should emphasize NPU device compatibility, performance, and correctness and stability of new features.

2026-03-12.zh: 今日研发重点聚焦于Graph/Runtime、xllm/core及设备后端模块，完成了模型类型重构、性能优化及MLU序列并行前置条件的开发。高风险改动主要集中在设备后端的FP8 GEMM性能优化和MLU序列并行功能，测试需重点关注多设备深度搜索注意力机制、环境变量生效及Ascend平台兼容性。整体测试应覆盖模型调用正确性、性能提升及多轮解码功能的稳定性。
2026-03-12.en: Today's development focused on the Graph/Runtime, xllm/core, and device backend modules, including model type refactoring, performance optimizations, and prerequisites for MLU sequence parallelism. High-risk changes are mainly in device backend FP8 GEMM performance tuning and MLU sequence parallel features. Testing should emphasize multi-device deepseek attention, environment variable correctness, and Ascend platform compatibility, covering model correctness, performance improvements, and multi-round decoding stability.

2026-03-11.zh: 今日研发重点涵盖设备后端、xllm/c_api、推理引擎及MoE模块，新增多模态补全接口和融合TopK层等关键特性。高风险改动主要集中在xllm/c_api和MoE模块，测试需重点关注接口性能、多模态功能、融合TopK层的正确性及设备后端线性计算的稳定性。部分模块进行了重构，需验证类型转换和单元测试的稳定性。
2026-03-11.en: Today's development focused on key modules including Device Backend, xllm/c_api, Inference Engine, and MoE, introducing features such as multimodal completions and a fused TopK layer. High-risk changes are mainly in xllm/c_api and MoE modules, with testing emphasis on interface performance, multimodal functionality, fused TopK correctness, and stability of linear computations in the device backend. Refactoring efforts require validation of type conversions and unit test stability.

2026-07-30.zh: 今日研发重点围绕Graph/Runtime、推理引擎及MoE模块，新增了MUSA设备相关核函数及兼容性支持，同时完善了推理引擎请求参数功能。高风险改动主要集中在核心计算核函数和推理引擎参数处理，测试需重点验证新核函数性能、请求参数准确性及多节点通信的稳定性。构建配置重构也需关注构建流程的正常运行。
2026-07-30.en: Today's development focused on the Graph/Runtime, Inference Engine, and MoE modules, adding new kernels and compatibility for MUSA devices and enhancing request parameter support in the inference engine. High-risk changes are centered on core computation kernels and request parameter handling, with testing emphasizing kernel performance, parameter accuracy, and multi-node communication stability. Refactoring of build configurations also requires verification of build process integrity.

2026-03-09.zh: 今日研发重点涵盖Graph/Runtime和设备后端模块，完成了CUDA激活核测试覆盖及MLU序列并行前置条件构建。修复了NPU后端deepseekv32工具调用和CUDA设备预填充精度问题，风险较低。测试重点关注激活核正确性、并行状态初始化及CUDA预填充和解码的准确性与性能。
2026-03-09.en: Today's development focused on Graph/Runtime and device backend modules, including adding CUDA activation kernel test coverage and building sequence parallel prerequisites for MLU. Bug fixes addressed deepseekv32 tool call issues in the NPU backend and precision problems in CUDA device prefill, with low risk. Testing should emphasize activation kernel correctness, parallel state initialization, and accuracy and performance of CUDA prefill and decode operations.

2026-03-07.zh: 今日研发主要聚焦于xllm/core、模型支持及设备后端模块，完成多项功能新增与关键bug修复。重点支持了LongCat-Image-Edit在CUDA设备上的适配及多模态模型调度重叠功能，风险较低但需关注CUDA环境下的新功能兼容性和多轮推理的正确性。测试应重点验证构建流程、助手消息处理稳定性及Ascend平台相关功能的性能表现。
2026-03-07.en: Today's development focused on xllm/core, model support, and device backend modules, delivering several feature additions and critical bug fixes. Key updates include support for LongCat-Image-Edit on CUDA devices and schedule overlap in multimodal models, with low risk but requiring testing on CUDA compatibility and multi-round inference correctness. Testing should emphasize build process validation, assistant message stability, and performance on the Ascend platform.

2026-03-06.zh: 今日研发重点涵盖Graph/Runtime、xllm/core、设备及NPU后端等多个核心模块，新增多轮对话logprob返回和REC多轮两阶段xattention支持。涉及高风险性能优化，特别是Ascend平台上的kvcache哈希算法和推测解码流水线优化。测试需重点关注多轮交互正确性、CUDA Graph性能、状态管理及单元测试构建稳定性。
2026-03-06.en: Today's development focused on core modules including Graph/Runtime, xllm/core, device and NPU backends, introducing multi-round dialogue logprob return and REC multi-round two-stage xattention support. High-risk performance optimizations were made, especially on the Ascend platform for kvcache hash algorithm and speculative decoding pipeline. Testing should emphasize multi-round interaction correctness, CUDA Graph performance, state management, and unit test build stability.

2026-03-05.zh: 今日研发主要聚焦于设备后端、模型支持及图计算运行时模块，完成了融合RMSNorm和静态FP8量化以提升性能，新增对joyai-llm-flash模型在mlu设备上的支持，并修复了NPU处理组返回值错误。整体风险较低，测试重点关注性能提升、数值稳定性、模型兼容性及返回值正确性。确保各模块功能稳定和性能优化效果显著。
2026-03-05.en: Today's development focused on the device backend, model support, and graph/runtime modules, implementing fused RMSNorm and static FP8 quantization for performance improvement, adding support for the joyai-llm-flash model on mlu devices, and fixing an incorrect return value in the NPU process group. The overall risk is low, with testing emphasis on performance gains, numerical stability, model compatibility, and return value correctness to ensure stable functionality and effective optimizations.

2026-03-04.zh: 今日研发重点聚焦于Graph/Runtime模块，新增了动态多模型支持、Qwen3模型在musa设备上的支持及GLM5模型在NPU设备上的支持，同时实现了APIService的RPC接口。重构工作涉及依赖关系调整和执行器优化，整体存在较高风险，特别是在Ascend平台上的兼容性。测试需重点关注多模型管理、设备适配、RPC接口性能及依赖稳定性，确保新功能和重构改动的正确性与稳定性。
2026-03-04.en: Today's development focused on the Graph/Runtime module, introducing dynamic multi-model support, Qwen3 model support on musa devices, GLM5 model support on NPU devices, and implementing the RPC interface in APIService. Refactoring efforts addressed dependency adjustments and executor optimizations, with high risk especially regarding Ascend platform compatibility. Testing should emphasize multi-model management, device adaptation, RPC interface performance, and dependency stability to ensure correctness and reliability of new features and refactors.
